title: Beautiful red, 82" long
text: Beautiful red, 82" long. Perfect red for the holidays. I wouldn’t say these are thermal insulated at all, or that they are sound proof or even total blackout curtains but they’re good for the low price. I can definitely feel the cold winds with these up so probably won’t keep them up for long… The grommets are plastic though which took me by surprise. Very light weight, good if you can’t hang real heavy drapes. Oh, and these are only 82" long, not 84" like the description says. I know they're cheap, but seriously? At least get the size right...
